performance_review.note: 807 workspace tests and all39 primary plus48 confirmation processes passed. Retained with an explicit2.2-2.5% IPv6 read tradeoff; disk sampled-tail worsening remains an open caveat. Goal active: RAM singles, loading, setup, reopening, allocation and some write latencies still trail LMDB. Published values come from the primary39-process campaign; confirmation results are separate.
